name: module-hierarchy-needs-project-modules-first
body: DeclarationEmitter.EmitModuleHierarchy finds a collision-qualified parent's project prefix by matching the shortest prefix already present in the scanner's emitted-module set, so it depends on EmitProjectModules having run first; without it a qualified parent would be split at every dot of the project path. Upgrade by passing the project path in explicitly if Scanner.Run's pass order ever changes.
